title.zh: 在索索贡省Pilar市镇设立急诊医院，名称为Pilar急诊医院，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Pilar, in the Province of Sorsogon, to Be Known as Pilar Emergency Hospital, and to Appropriate Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish An Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Pilar, in the Province of Sorsogon, to Be Known as Pilar Emergency Hospital, and to Appropriate Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Cấp cứu tại Thị trấn Pilar, Tỉnh Sorsogon với tên gọi Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Pilar, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉินในเทศบาล Pilar จังหวัด Sorsogon ในชื่อโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Pilar และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat di Kotamadya Pilar, Provinsi Sorsogon dengan nama Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat Pilar, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Pilar in the Province of Sorsogon, to be known as Pilar Emergency Hospital.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy-one. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
